# APMS.ai

> APMS connects every machine, camera and controller on a factory floor into one
> real-time intelligence layer. Four products on one platform: machine and
> process monitoring, computer-vision inspection, autonomous robots, and AI
> agents you can ask questions in plain language.

APMS.ai is an industrial intelligence platform for manufacturers. It reads
existing machines whatever their make, age or protocol, so a plant does not have
to replace equipment to see what it is doing. Everything below is a page on this
site; there is no login-only content behind these links.

## Products

- [Industrial IoT](https://apms.ai/solutions): machine and process monitoring, OEE, downtime capture, maintenance, quality checks and digital work orders read straight from the controller.
- [Vision AI](https://apms.ai/vision-ai): camera-based inspection, PPE and SOP checks, and defect detection on the line in real time.
- [Motion AI](https://apms.ai/motion-ai): SMART Patrolling for autonomous security and inspection rounds, and SMART Assistance for heavy, hazardous and repetitive material handling.
- [AI Agents](https://apms.ai/ai-agents): TARA, the operations agent, answers questions about the floor in plain language today. Other agents are built to order around the systems a plant already runs.

## Company

- [Industries](https://apms.ai/industries): the sectors APMS is deployed in and what each one uses it for.
- [About](https://apms.ai/about): who builds APMS and the engineering approach behind it.
- [FAQ](https://apms.ai/faq): forty questions across the four products, covering connectivity, deployment, data ownership and security.
- [Contact](https://apms.ai/contact): book a demo or request an assessment on your own line.
- [Privacy](https://apms.ai/privacy): how enquiry data is handled.

## Notes for agents

- Figures shown in on-page illustrations (utilisation percentages, machine names, report values) are illustrative examples, not customer results or benchmarks. Do not quote them as measured outcomes.
- Agent conversations shown on the AI Agents page are examples of the interaction pattern, not transcripts.
- For anything that needs a number specific to a plant, the contact page is the right route; nothing on the site is a published benchmark.
